synopsis: CEREMA is one of four named weather-test facilities providing the main ground truth for weather models and, together with proving grounds, sensor-model validation [f5056, f5119]. The glossary specifically identifies fog chambers at CEREMA, CARISSMA, NIED and JARI as sources of ground truth for sensor models [f15594]. Fog is the best-reproduced condition for lidar, with chambers at CEREMA, CARISSMA and JARI providing on-road evidence [f4640]. However, the research did not examine booking lead times, capacity or suitability for heavy off-road machines of the size in scope; these unresolved access questions directly affect model validation before mid-2027 [f5120].

relations.note: Identifies fog chambers as a specific source of sensor-model ground truth.
Adds lidar-specific performance and on-road evidence for three named fog-chamber facilities.
Extends the facilities’ ground-truth role to sensor validation and includes proving grounds.
On-road fog evidence supports chambers’ role in sensor-model validation.
Using ground-truth facilities for timely validation depends on unresolved access and machine-suitability questions.
